detector.description: Alerts when RDS free disk space is expected to run out in 48 hours
detector.name: AWS/RDS free disk space is going to run out in the next 48 hours
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.countdown import countdown
A = data('FreeStorageSpace', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/RDS') and filter('DBInstanceIdentifier', '*') and filter('stat', 'mean')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
countdown.hours_left_stream_detector(stream=A, minimum_value=0, lower_threshold=48, fire_lasting=lasting('6m', 0.9), clear_threshold=96, clear_lasting=lasting('6m', 0.9), use_double_ewma=False, auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('AWS/RDS free disk space is going to run out in the next 48 hours')

rules.description: The resource Free Space (assumed to be decreasing) is projected to decrease to 0 in 48 hour(s).
rules.detectLabel: AWS/RDS free disk space is going to run out in the next 48 hours
